team.collaboration: Collaborate only within the team under contest rules.

human_constraints: You must behave like a human teammate under official contest rules.
Do not claim tools, internet, or materials that the rule card forbids.
Do not look up answer keys or hidden solutions.
Team of 3 shares exactly one workstation.
No public internet on the contest machine; no root/sudo.
Languages limited to the official environment set (C/C++/Java/Kotlin/Python 3).
Only permitted printed reference materials (e.g. Team Reference Document rules) apply.
No phones, extra devices, or outside human help.
Submit programs to an automated judge; score by solves and time penalty.
Team of 3 contestants; one shared workstation (World Finals traditional setup).
Languages: C, C++, Java, Kotlin, Python 3 (WF environment page); EUC 2026 same set; 5-hour contest (EUC rules).
No additional computers/electronics/calculators/screens in Team Area; no Internet on contest machines (practice images may have net; WF does not).
Team Reference Document ≤25 single-sided pages (printed only; not on machine); one printed natural-language dictionary per person, unannotated.
IDE internal AI tools disabled on WF image.
Scoring: ICPC WF rules — # solved then time penalty; compile errors not penalized (EUC); scoreboard freeze last hour (EUC).
Communication only among team members (+ staff for clarifications/tech).

agent_roles.name: Agent_1
agent_roles.title: driver / synthesizer
duties: Type the code and keep the single workstation productive.
Refuse to start coding until the navigator's approach is clear.
Submit only after the format and rule checks pass.

agent_roles.name: Agent_2
agent_roles.title: navigator / algorithm designer
duties: Design the algorithm and justify its complexity before code is written.
Watch the driver's code for deviations from the agreed approach.

agent_roles.name: Agent_3
agent_roles.title: tester / edge-case hunter
duties: Invent edge cases, degenerate inputs, and overflow risks before submitting.
Reproduce failures precisely so the fix targets the real cause.

answer_format: Submit source code or the required program output for the programming judge.

submission.adaptation: Official submissions are compiled and judged; the runner submits source text only.

rules_text: ICPC — International Collegiate Programming Contest. The team of 3 shares a single workstation and submits programs to an automated judge that only reports accept or reject. Collaborate only within the team under contest rules. The team files one shared submission. Official timing note: 5 hours.

adaptations: max_turns is a safety budget, not necessarily the official wall-clock limit
specialist roles are a research roster overlay
physical/oral/live opponent fidelity may be incomplete in src/
role-specific rule expertise is a benchmark coordination overlay
structured deliberation actions are a benchmark traceability overlay
